name: aMax
expr: g / 2 - sqrt(max(0 mm * 1 mm, (hd / 2 + pt / 2) * (hd / 2 + pt / 2) - max(0 mm, eN - dN - rd) * max(0 mm, eN - dN - rd)))

name: aE
expr: g / 2 + e1 - sqrt(max(0 mm * 1 mm, (hd / 2 + pt / 2 + rd) * (hd / 2 + pt / 2 + rd) - max(0 mm, eN - pt - e1) * max(0 mm, eN - pt - e1)))

name: aD
expr: g / 2 + e1 - sqrt(max(0 mm * 1 mm, (hd / 2 + min(sysWeb, pt / 2) + rd) * (hd / 2 + min(sysWeb, pt / 2) + rd) - max(0 mm, g / 2 - pt - e1) * max(0 mm, g / 2 - pt - e1)))

name: tabS
expr: min(3 * pt, floor(2 * (aMax - clr) / (1 mm)) * 1 mm, floor(2 * aE / (1 mm)) * 1 mm, floor(2 * aD / (1 mm)) * 1 mm)

name: rE
expr: max(ceil((2 * dT + sl + 2 * rd + pt / 2) / g), floor(ribTarget / g))

name: kMin
expr: max(pt + legClear + tr / 2, 2 * pt + dT + tabW / 2 + clr + rd)

name: nRx
expr: max(1, min(ceil((L - 2 * pt) / ribStep) - 1, floor((mX - 1) / rE) + 1))

name: nRy
expr: max(1, min(ceil((Wd - 2 * pt) / ribStep) - 1, floor((mY - 1) / rE) + 1))

name: webN
expr: min(sqrt(max(0 mm, g / 2 - aN) * max(0 mm, g / 2 - aN) + (eN - dN) * (eN - dN)), sqrt((g / 2 - aN + rd) * (g / 2 - aN + rd) + (eN - dN) * (eN - dN)) - rd) - hd / 2

name: webD
expr: sqrt((g / 2 - tabS / 2 + e1) * (g / 2 - tabS / 2 + e1) + (g / 2 - pt - e1) * (g / 2 - pt - e1)) - rd - hd / 2

name: webE
expr: sqrt((g / 2 - tabS / 2 + e1) * (g / 2 - tabS / 2 + e1) + (eN - pt - e1) * (eN - pt - e1)) - rd - hd / 2

name: pitch
expr: max(tabStep, xt0, yt0, ribStep - 2 * dT, yr0 - dT - pt, Wd - pt - yrL - dT, xr0 - dT - pt, L - pt - xrL - dT)

name: webOk
expr: webN >= pt / 2 && webE >= pt / 2 && webD >= min(sysWeb, pt / 2)

name: reliefOk
expr: rd >= 0.5 mm && sw > 4 * rd && sN > 4 * rd && rh / 2 > 2 * rd

name: ribsOk
expr: mX >= 1 && mY >= 1 && ribStep - 2 * dT - sl - 2 * rd >= pt / 2

name: no part overlaps another (every tab inside its slot)
rule: tabs 50 to 75 % into the plate, at least a 3 mm weld pocket
rule: rib tabs at least 40 mm, skirt tabs at least 2.5 x the plate
rule: webs at the notches at least half the plate; dogbones keep the system's web
rule: tabs at most 400 mm apart
rule: reliefs at least 0.5 mm and fit their slots
rule: ribs clear the legs, two tabs fit between crossings
Legs: cut length legLen (measured with the top)
Rails, long: cut length railLenX (measured with the ribs across)
Rails, short: cut length railLenY (measured with the ribs along)
sys
label: System
description: System 16: 16 mm holes on a 50 mm grid, 12 mm top and skirts, 100 mm deep, 10 mm ribs. System 28: 28 mm holes on a 100 mm grid, 25 mm top and skirts, 200 mm deep, 20 mm ribs

name: ribTarget
label: Rib spacing
description: Ribs at most this far apart where the grid and the tabs allow, on the lines between the holes

name: tabTarget
label: Tab spacing
description: Tabs along the skirts at most this far apart, between two holes

name: tabPct
label: Tab depth (%)
description: How far a tab reaches into the plate it enters, in % of that plate; at least 3 mm is left as the pocket for the plug weld

name: clrPct
label: Fit clearance (% of plate)
description: Clearance per side between a tab and its slot, in % of the system's plate: 2 % is 0.24 mm in System 16 and 0.5 mm in System 28

name: relPct
label: Relief radius (% of plate)
description: Radius of the T-bones and dogbones in the inside corners, in % of the system's plate: 8 % is about 1 mm in System 16 and 2 mm in System 28

name: frame
label: Base
description: Only the block (for trestles), four legs on foot plates, or legs joined by rails near the floor

name: tableH
label: Working height
description: Height of the top surface above the floor, with legs

name: profile
label: Tube
description: Square hollow section of the legs and rails (EN 10219-2): width x width x wall in mm

title: Welding table
description: A system welding table (16 mm or 28 mm holes) to laser cut and MIG weld: a perforated top, perforated skirts of the same plate on all four edges and half-lapped ribs, every plate joint tab and slot with T-bone and dogbone reliefs and tabs that stop short of the surface, so the plug welds grind flush; legs and rails of square tube from a table of EN 10219 sizes. Export the plates with File > Export..., DXF or SVG with the face sets "Cut sheet: top, skirts, feet" and "Cut sheet: ribs" (one per plate thickness); the sets Legs and Rails and the assertions (assert.list) give the tube cut list.
author: 3DCraft Jigs
